purpose: Teach: 供養/守護/物色/不特定/贈与/再婚/勝訴/虚構

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦死者供養の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the veneration of war dead, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady confirmation—not a question, an acknowledgment. Slight pause before 'Sakura.' Clear, attentive gaze. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and is drawing out the student's thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、地域の守護神信仰を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on local guardian deity beliefs in my paper.
lines.style: Direct, earnest. A slight lift at the start as if correcting the premise gently. Eyes meeting hers. Respectful but not deferential—this is her work, her research.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 企業が物色する人材の傾向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined corporate recruitment trends in your paper, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pause. Leaning slightly forward. The tone of someone following a thread of thought out loud, curious where it leads. Not checking boxes—genuinely considering.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、不特定多数を狙ったテロを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper covered indiscriminate terrorism targeting the general public.
lines.style: Steady and direct. A beat of emphasis on 'indiscriminate.' No apology in her voice, just clear statement of her actual research. Unflinching eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 遺産贈与の法制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you handled inheritance and gift law in your paper?
lines.style: Engaged, actively listening. A slight tilt of the head. Warm but precise—she's tracking the pattern and wants to understand what Sakura is actually saying.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の再婚率の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined postwar remarriage patterns from a sociological angle.
lines.style: Calm and clear. A slight steadiness in the delivery, as if anchoring herself. Respectful but confident. This is what she studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 市民訴訟で勝訴した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And civil litigation cases where the plaintiff won—you wrote about those?
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful. Slight pause at the beginning. Following the thread with genuine interest. The rhythm of someone piecing something together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、メディアが作り出す虚構を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper analyzed how media constructs fiction and narrative.
lines.style: Direct, final. A note of quiet conviction underneath. Not rushed, but complete—the closing of one thread and the fullness of her actual research laid bare.
